about_us.title: About Us
about_us.subtitle: Volta Stabilizer & Electrical Solutions
about_us.description: Volta Stabilizer & Electrical Solutions is a leading company providing integrated and innovative electrical solutions with extensive experience in the field. Volta is a limited liability company and an extension of Al-Handasia for Electrical Protection, which was established in 2011. Volta is the exclusive agent of the STABILIZER VOLTA brand, offering some of the best voltage stabilizers and transformers in Egypt. It is also the exclusive agent of the VOLTAFAY brand, which provides a wide range of electrical protection devices and related products that have proven their efficiency over years in the Egyptian market.
about_us.vision_text: To be one of the leading companies in voltage stabilization systems and energy solutions in Egypt through continuous innovation and commitment to the highest quality standards.
about_us.mission_text: To provide effective and safe electrical solutions that simplify our customers’ lives, while delivering outstanding customer service and continuous technical support.
what_we_offer_items: Stabilizers (voltage regulators) with various capacities for residential, commercial, and industrial use.
Protection solutions against voltage surges and drops.
Design and implementation of electrical panels of all types.
Technical consultations to select the most suitable solutions.
Maintenance services and specialized technical support.
why_volta_items: Commitment to deadlines and after-sales service.
Highly trained and specialized technical team.
Dedicated customer service to meet client requirements.
about_us.our_clients_text: We are proud to serve a wide range of clients including individuals, companies, factories, electrical supply stores, and electrical appliance showrooms. We always strive to build long-term relationships based on trust and credibility.
about_us.contact_us_text: We are here to help you choose the most suitable electrical solution for your needs. Do not hesitate to contact us for technical consultation or a customized quotation.
about_us.address: Address: Villa 869, Ground Floor – Third District (Consultants District) – New Beni Suef City – Beni Suef Governorate – Egypt

return_policy.title: Return & Refund Policy
return_policy.welcome: Welcome to our official Return & Refund Policy page. We are committed to providing a comfortable and secure shopping experience and ensuring customer satisfaction with the products received. Please review the following Return & Refund Policy carefully:
return_policy.important: Important: You have 14 days from the date of receipt to return the product if the reason is a change of mind, provided that the return conditions are met. In case of a visible defect or damage, you must notify us within 48 hours of receipt.
return_policy.condition_48h: For a product to be eligible for return within 48 hours (due to damage or a clear defect), the product must be:
return_policy.condition_48h_item: Complete with all components and in its original packaging, even if the packaging has been opened.
return_policy.condition_opinion: For a product to be eligible for return due to a change of mind, the product must be:
return_policy.condition_opinion_item: In the same condition as received.
return_policy.condition_manufacturing: For a product to be eligible for return due to a manufacturing defect, the following is required:
condition_manufacturing_items: Technical approval from the company’s specialists.
The product must be complete with all components and in its original packaging, even if the packaging has been opened.
return_policy.periods_desc: The timeframe for initiating the return process depends on the reason for return:
periods_items: Damaged product or visible defect: Within 48 hours from the date of receipt.
Change of mind: Within 14 days from the date of receipt.
Manufacturing defect: Within 30 days from the date of receipt.
return_policy.non_returnable_desc: Some products cannot be returned due to their nature, such as:
return_policy.non_returnable_item: Inverter devices that may be damaged due to incorrect installation or connection.
return_policy.how_to_start_title: 4. How to Start a Return Process
return_policy.how_to_start_desc: Please follow the steps below to complete your return request:

steps.title: Submit a request:
steps.text: When you register your return request through our Customer Service representative by contacting 0122224564 or via our social media pages, you will be informed of the scheduled period for collecting the returned item. During this period, the shipping representative will contact you to coordinate the pickup time.

steps.title: Packaging:
steps.text: Ensure the product is securely packed in its original packaging along with all accessories and documents.

steps.title: Pickup:
steps.text: The shipping representative will contact you to schedule the pickup.

steps.title: Inspection:
steps.text: If the return request is approved, the refunded amount will be transferred to your e-wallet or InstaPay account within 48 hours. The complete return process may take 5 to 10 working days.

steps.title: Refund:
steps.text: After passing the inspection, the refund process will be completed.

return_policy.footer_note: Rest assured — you are working with a company committed to professionalism, integrity, and customer respect.

shipping_policy.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping_policy.description: At Volta Stabilizer & Electrical Solutions, we partner with shipping companies to handle the delivery of orders, ensuring our customers across Egypt receive reliable service. Please review the following Shipping & Delivery Policy:
shipping_policy.scope_desc: We ship to all governorates across the Arab Republic of Egypt. Customers will be notified if shipping is unavailable to certain areas.
processing_items: Orders are processed within 1 business day from the date of order confirmation.
Orders confirmed after 12:00 PM may be processed on the next business day.
Processing time does not include public holidays or weekends.
shipping_policy.delivery_time_desc: Delivery time depends on the customer’s location:
shipping_policy.delivery_time_estimate: Estimated delivery time for customers is 3 to 5 business days. Delivery may take longer during promotional periods or exceptional circumstances.
fees_items: Shipping fees are calculated based on the geographic location and product weight/size.
Shipping costs are clearly displayed before completing payment.
Free shipping may be offered during promotions or for orders above a certain value.
confirmation_items: Customers will be contacted to confirm the order before shipping (via phone or SMS).
If contact cannot be made, the company reserves the right to cancel the order to maintain service quality.
receiving_items: Please inspect the product upon delivery.
If visible damage to the product or packaging is found, the shipping company must be notified immediately and the issue documented.
Signing for the delivery indicates that the product has been received in apparent good condition.
shipping_policy.delays_desc: Delays may occur due to circumstances beyond our control, including:
shipping_policy.delays_footer: In such cases, we will make every effort to keep the customer informed.
address_items: Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete shipping information.
Incorrect addresses may result in additional reshipping fees.
